question: Who was India’s flag-bearer for the closing ceremony of the 18th Asian Games 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rani Rampal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rani Rampal** was **India's flag-bearer **for the closing ceremony of the **18th Asian Games 2018.**
 
• Rani Rampal is a renowned Indian **women's hockey player** who has been awarded the **Arjuna Award and Padma Shri.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PT Usha** is a former **Indian track and field athlete** who has won numerous medals in international events like the** Asian Games and Asian Championships. **
 
• **Hima Das** is an Indian sprinter who has won** gold medals** in the **2018 Asian Games** and the **2018 IAAF World U20 Championships.**
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is an **Indian javelin thrower **who won a** gold** medal in the** 2018 Asian Games and the 2018 Commonwealth Games.**
